subject: Renewal: invoice routing, PO split & billing contacts for 2027 capacity renewal
messages:
From: Prakash Shah <prakash@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, finance@acme-analytics.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Account renewal: invoice routing and PO split for 2027

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — Acme is preparing the paperwork for our annual commitment renewal and an additional capacity add-on. A few billing items to confirm before we issue POs so procurement can get the approvals in the next week: 

- We want to convert our monthly commit to an annual committed capacity and add an extra 200k token block to the commitment line.
- Invoices need to be split between two legal entities: Acme Analytics, Inc. (US) and Acme Analytics EU, GmbH (Germany). Our procurement team requires separate POs and tax invoices for each entity.
- Requested terms: Net60 (we understand standard is Net30 but procurement requires Net60 for this purchase).
- Please confirm the billing contacts for each entity and the billing email addresses so we can route approval.
- We’ll attach draft PO(s) and the W-9 / EU VAT registration once legal has them in finalized form, but please advise any specific fields you need on the PO (billing address, remit-to, EIN/VAT).

Attaching a draft PO for now: Acme_PO_draft_2027.pdf (stub).

Can you confirm if Redwood can: 1) issue two separate invoices tied to the same renewal amendment, and 2) accommodate Net60 on this deal?

Thanks — if it’s easier I can jump on a 20-min call this week.

Best,
Prakash
Director, Procurement
Acme Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Prakash Shah <prakash@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Account renewal: invoice routing and PO split for 2027

Thanks for the clear note, Prakash — and thanks for the draft PO.

We can support a split invoicing approach in principle, but there are a couple of steps on our side to make it clean for AR and procurement: 

- Sales/Finance alignment: We’ll need the split percentages or amounts that should be billed to the US vs EU entities (so we mirror that on the amendment). If you can confirm 70/30 or an exact dollar allocation that helps.
- Tax & identity: Please attach the US EIN/W-9 for Acme Analytics, Inc. and the EU VAT registration for the German entity. Those are required for our billing records and to generate correct tax invoices.
- PO details: The PO should include the exact billing address and remit-to. If procurement already has PO numbers, include them and we’ll reference them on the invoices.
- Terms: Net60 will need sign-off from our Finance team — Ben and Neha I’ve cc’d for visibility. We’ll flag this as a billing exception and run it through approvals (could add 1–3 business days). If approved, we’ll include Net60 on the amendment and invoices.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Acme confirms split allocation and sends W-9 + VAT certs.
2) Ben/Neha review and confirm Net60 approval and whether we need to split the deal in HubSpot for separate billing entities.
3) I’ll create an amendment that adds the capacity and captures both POs/terms and route to legal for signature (DocuSign).

If that works I’ll draft the amendment today and post a HubSpot link. If you prefer a short call to finalize allocation and contacts, I have availability tomorrow morning.

—Marissa
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Account renewal: invoice routing and PO split for 2027

Marissa — quick ops note from finance:

- Finance is generally fine issuing two invoices against the same amendment provided the total committed amount and revenue recognition schedule are clear. We typically record two invoice entities in our billing system and map them to the same parent deal.
- Net60 is an exception to standard terms. We can approve Net60 for this account on a case-by-case basis but need: (a) signed amendment that references Net60; (b) credit/AR check completed by our billing ops (should be quick for repeat customers); (c) procurement PO numbers.
- Required docs: US EIN or W-9, and EU VAT registration number (PDF).

If Acme confirms a 70/30 split (US 70% / EU 30%) we’ll: 
1) create two billing contacts in the ledger and two invoice schedules, linked to DEAL-98765.
2) prepare a two-line amendment for the capacity add-on with clear allocations and the two PO numbers on the amendment so the legal/docuSign flow is clean.
3) share a draft invoice-split-template.xlsx for Procurement to review fields we populate on the invoices (attached).

HubSpot deal for ops reference: https://app.hubspot.com/12345/deal/DEAL-98765

Ben
Sr. Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

> On Apr 1, 2027, at 3:30 PM, Marissa Cole wrote:
> > We can support a split invoicing approach in principle...

From: Prakash Shah <prakash@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, finance@acme-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Account renewal: invoice routing and PO split for 2027

Marissa / Ben / Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming details from procurement: 

- Allocation: US (Acme Analytics, Inc.) — 70% of committed amount. EU (Acme Analytics EU, GmbH) — 30%.
- PO numbers: PO-US-7789 (for the US entity) and PO-EU-3321 (for the EU entity). Please reference both on the amendment and on the respective invoices.
- Billing contacts: 
  - US billing: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@acme-analytics.com>, Accounts Payable, Acme Analytics, Inc.
  - EU billing: Lars Meier <lars.meier@acme-analytics.eu>, Accounting, Acme Analytics EU, GmbH
- Attached are the tax docs (stubs): Acme_W9_2027.pdf (EIN included) and Acme_VAT_cert_2027.pdf.

We are happy to proceed with a DocuSign amendment that includes the capacity add-on, the 70/30 split, and the two PO numbers. If Finance approves Net60 on your end, we’ll expect the invoices to reflect Net60 and be routed to the corresponding billing contacts.

Can you please share pro forma invoices (drafts) for each entity so procurement has the numbers for internal approvals? Once we have the drafts and DocuSign route we’ll push the POs through procurement.

Thanks,
Prakash
Director, Procurement
Acme Analytics
